news.analysis: Allen tallied his lowest passing yards total of the season, but was able to turn in a solid day with three total touchdowns. Allen has thrown an interception in three straight games and will look to break that streak against Miami in Week 11.
news.contents: Josh Allen completed 11-of-21 passes for 196 yards, one touchdown, and one interception in a 31-12 win over the Jets. He added five rushing yards and two touchdowns on five attempts.
news.title: Josh Allen rushes for two touchdowns in Week 10 win

news.analysis: Allen took a backseat to Breece Hall for the second straight week since Hall's return to the lineup. Allen remains a handcuff at best heading into a Week 11 matchup with the Chargers.
news.contents: Braelon Allen rushed for 40 yards on eight carries in a 31-12 loss to the Bills. He caught his lone target for six yards.
news.title: Braelon Allen sees nine touches in Week 10 loss

news.contents: New York Jets running back Braelon Allen was once again an afterthought in the offense on Sunday. Allen was running wild on opposing defense when Breece Hall was out, but now he's struggling to make a significant impact. In Week 10, Allen carried the ball eight times for 40 yards and hauled in his lone target for six yards in the loss. This marks the second straight week that Allen has been held to under 10 carries. He continues to run the ball well, but his role is limited with Hall back in ...
news.title: Braelon Allen Sees Limited Role in Week 10

news.analysis: McMillan led the team in targets with seven, but was only able to convert that into three receptions, his lowest total since Week 2. The 23-year-old will look to bounce back against Baltimore in Week 11.
news.contents: Tetairoa McMillan caught 3-of-7 targets for 35 yards in a 20-17 win over the Saints.
news.title: Tetairoa McMillan hauls in three passes in Week 10

news.contents: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan recorded three receptions (on seven targets) for 35 yards (11.7 yards per reception) and no touchdowns in a 20-17 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 10. While McMillan led the team in targets, he finished third in receptions and third in receiving yards behind running back Chuba Hubbard (five receptions for 80 yards) and tight end Tommy Tremble (four catches for 48 yards). Quarterback Bryce Young was held to 200 passing yards against the...
news.title: Tetairoa McMillan Held to 35 Yards Versus Saints

news.analysis: Boston dealt with a toe injury all week, but he practiced Friday and took the field Sunday. The rookie was not able to produce much for fantasy managers, however, finishing with fewer than three catches for just the second time over the last seven games. Boston has had a nice rookie season to this point and should rebound quickly.
news.contents: Denzel Boston caught 1-of-2 targets for 18 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Texans.
news.title: Denzel Boston finishes with just one catch in Week 10

news.contents: Cleveland Browns wide receiver Denzel Boston (toe) caught just one pass for 16 yards in a 27-24 win against the Houston Texans in Week 10. The 22-year-old missed practice time and was questionable to play on Sunday due to the toe injury he sustained in Week 9 against the New Orleans Saints, but he told reporters after the win against Houston that his toe is "going to be okay," according to Browns reporter Ashley Bastock. news.analysis: Penix Jr. has struggled to make an impact behind center of late, throwing one or more interceptions in each of the last three games. The quarterback faces a disruptive Minnesota Vikings defense in Week 12 after the team's Week 11 bye.
news.contents: Michael Penix Jr. completed 23-of-43 pass attempts for 286 yards and one interception while also rushing four times for 29 yards in the Falcons' 35-13 Week 10 loss to the Chiefs.

news.contents: Atlanta Falcons quarterback Michael Penix Jr. began the season with a 9:1 TD:INT over his first five games, but has since thrown just one touchdown and five interceptions over the last two contests. news.contents: New York Jets tight end Mason Taylor is losing steam in the team's pass attack as teammate Kenyon Sadiq has begun to command a larger share of snaps. Taylor missed time earlier in the year with a thumb injury, but was largely the Jets' snap leader at the position week in and week out. In fact, the former LSU Tiger had a productive outing in Week 7's loss to the Dolphins, even with all of New York's pass-catching options available.
